One Platform to Reduce Risk Where It Starts:
Human and Agentic Decisions

Every decision your people make and every action your AI agents take counts. The KnowBe4 Platform uses AI to connect threat detection, real-time coaching, and risk scoring to reduce risk across your entire workforce.

Attack Simulation & Training

AI-driven security awareness training that goes beyond checkbox courses. Run realistic simulations for deepfakes, phishing, vishing, and multi-channel scams, then get timely, personalized coaching right after a risky click.

Explore Training

Email & Collaboration Security

Behavioral AI that extends a security layer across the entire communication stack, catching the inbound and outbound anomalies traditional filters miss.

Explore Email & Collaboration

Agent Security

Production-ready governance for the AI agents already working in your organization. Get a centralized agent inventory, detect unauthorized Shadow AI, and enforce real-time controls to prevent agents from exfiltrating sensitive data.

Explore Agent Security

Get a unified Risk Score across the entire KnowBe4 Platform. It is a 0–100 score that's explainable, comparable across your entire organization, and recalculated daily so it always reflects present-day behavior.

Platform Overview
